message.content:
An editorial illustration on a magazine cover features a waist-up comic-style drawing of a man against a solid blue background. The man has a brown-toned complexion with a pink-dotted texture, dark hair, a mustache, and a short beard. He wears a white turban and a white collared shirt. His expression shows wide eyes and a slight grimace, revealing teeth. He holds a red telephone handset to his ear with both hands; his right ring finger bears a large ring with a red stone. 

At the top, large red letters spell “TEMPO” over white text stating “ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU”. Above this, white text reads “SALING SALIP PEMAIN FINTECH / DUA SEJOLI KORUPSI BENGKULU”. 

A yellow rectangular box in the upper left contains black text: “DARI PERSEMBUNYIANNYA, RIZIEQ SYIHAB MENGIRIM UTUSAN UNTUK MELOBI JOKOWI. GERTAK SAMBAL DARI SAUDI?”. 

A white circular speech bubble near the bottom left contains the bold black text “REKONSILIASI ATAU REVOLUSI !”. 

The bottom left corner includes date and price details: “3-9 JULI 2017”, “RP 45.000”, a website, and a barcode with numbers.
